name: cabinet-carcass
description: Eight wall cabinet carcasses in one material, 640 wide x 350 deep x 806 tall (25-1/4" x 13-3/4" x 31-3/4"). The point of this fixture is the spread of part sizes competing for the same sheets: 604 x 806 backs down to 604 x 150 rails. Sides and backs are grain-locked because they show. Hand-checked banding on usable 2430 x 1210, with every band filling its full width: an 806 band holds [back x 4] = 2425, a 350 band holds [side x 3] = 2424 or [604-wide part x 4] = 2425, a 150 band holds [rail x 4] = 2425. Two sheets banded 806 + 350 = 1159, three banded 350 x 3 + 150 = 1209. Five sheets, 10.2% waste at a perfect pack.
